notes.title: A small update
notes.content:
Hi Mandagon fans,

Just a small update - we will soon be making the Mandagon OST and digital art book available for free!

notes.title: A Mandagon Sequel (finally!)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25788547/50ded0efd122f5019b0dd8ebad4a1f085063061f.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to announce Mandagon: Bones of Clay.

This game will be a follow-up to Mandagon, expanding on its world, narrative and philosophies with a more fleshed out experience.

We’re super early into production right now, looking forward to showing more as we progress!

notes.title: Mandagon is coming to Android!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25788547/7c87cc3d0476843f0b506a173043c3b27cbf97b7.jpg[/img]

Howdy!

We’ve been having a little tinker, playing around with porting Mandagon to mobile. Turns out it’s still pretty fun on the small screen.

So we’ll be releasing Mandagon for Android in the near future! 

IOS port is also a possibility, but as I’m sure you can imagine it’s fiddly business porting things to various systems, so baby steps for now.

notes.title: EMPORIUM available now on steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25788547/9b5c5e2f5a2169030ffd59df22c1a49d076801b7.jpg[/img]

Hello,

Just letting ya’ll know that my little side project titled EMPORIUM is now available here on steam - click [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/635670/EMPORIUM/]HERE[/url][/b] for a closer look!

Emporium is a short interactive vignette. Exploring notions of escapism, loss and a fragmented sense of self in the wake of a personal tragedy.

These pockets of dissonant clarity are a vain effort to find beauty, poetry and reason in one's bleakest and most desperate moments.

Emporium is a small game lasting roughly 30 to 45 minuets. It has a minimal approach to game play, focusing on visuals and audio to build a visceral experience with sporadic dialogue choices leading the narrative.

notes.title: OST and Art Book DLC is out now!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25788547/1dd56d298132629d018a5ce9d4277961a44c3339.jpg[/img]

We are proud to announce that Mandagon’s OST and art book DLC is now available for download!

This little DLC pack contains a digital art book pdf showcasing in-game art, concept art and other thematic illustrations. 

The soundtrack will consist of a single 22 minute composition designed as a meditation aid or guide. Provided in flac and mp3 format. 

We’ve also included 4 desktop backgrounds in 16:9 (1920 x 1080) and 16:10 (1920 x 1200) 

Lastly there’s a ‘print and build a paper cube fella’ A4 printout for the arts and crafty types out there!

Click [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/515270/]here[/url] to be taken to the DLC store page.

notes.title: Interviews with Gadchet and Tricycle Magazine
notes.content:
Howdy, 

We recently did an interview with Gadchet which you can read [url=http://www.gadchet.tv/blind-sky-studios-interview/]here[/url]. We also spoke to Tricycle about the themes and ideas behind Mandagon which you can read [url=http://tricycle.org/trikedaily/explore-the-bardos-in-mandagon-a-video-game-inspired-by-tibetan-buddhism/]here[/url] should you be interested.

We’re currently addressing the bug reports that have been coming in. We’ll be making an update available in the near future. For now we’ve got our best, brightest and fluffiest QA testers on the case!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25788547/b6ed03e47a8ec5c29008ccdb33f32491de9ad4c4.jpg[/img]

Lastly thanks again for your continued support! OST and digital art book DLC is just around the corner!!

notes.title: Digital art book & OST coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25788547/8c8913bcf4ff9331fc416709788b602ac76caff6.png[/img]

We’re just putting the finishing touches on a digital art book and soundtrack DLC for Mandagon. We’ll have it ready for you real soon!

The soundtrack will consist of a single track lasting just over 20 minutes and is designed as a meditation aid or guide.

As well as the art book we’ll be including some extra treats like desktop backgrounds and alike.

There will be a small price tag on the DLC, so the option is available for anyone who is able to support Blind Sky Studios and our next little project :)

Lastly, Thanks again for all the kind words and downloads, my head is still spinning!!
